name: job-market-signal-tracker
description: Scrapes job postings, uses Claude to extract skills/roles/salary, and surfaces trends in an interactive dashboard.

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,magenta "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install && npm --prefix client run build
